proof_scope: Memory-native FastAPI control-plane contracts, API adapter, React data-qid surface, and hot-reload/dev verification scripts

claims.proves: the repo has a working pyproject, Pydantic contracts, API tests, Memory-first request validation, React data-qid checks, and a verification script
claims.does_not_prove: OpenAI/Astra internals, Azure deployment, live Hack scanning, or live Memory write success

cases.name: react-data-qid-contract
command: cd ../web && npm install --silent && npm run --silent verify:data-qid

cases.name: no-postgres-dependency
command:
from pathlib import Path
text=Path('../pyproject.toml').read_text().lower()
assert 'postgres' not in text and 'sqlalchemy' not in text and 'psycopg' not in text
